name: Milk and Cream
gmNotes:
Tutorial Side Mission for Mission Trackers, stealth/fail-forward play, domestic offerings, and the distinction between physical payment and Grace. It may be completed before or after Iron and Wax. Coinín conceals the true destination of the food without making a false assertion.

The village watch has been strengthened because horseshoes have recently vanished from doors and from the smithy. The beekeeper's apprentice stole them to protect the workshop from the Fey, but do not reveal the culprit merely because the GM knows it. If the player points out the coincidence between the missing horseshoes and the cache in Buaic's workshop, the apprentice will confess when confronted.
briefing: Coinín wants the cream and milk promised for his silence. Cross the watched palisade after dark, gather what the villagers have left outside their doors, and bring it back without turning the whole village against you.
objective: Collect ten measures of cream and two cans of milk, then deliver them to Coinín.
debriefing: The cream and milk are in Coinín's hands, and Trí Mhuilinn sleeps on—more or less. Only the honey remains, unless Buaic's errand has already supplied it.

storyBeats.title: Coinín's Instructions
storyBeats.events:
In the Hollow Tree, Coinín explains that villagers leave cream outside for household spirits. Normally he collects the offerings at night, but since yesterday the palisade and the village inside have been guarded for reasons he does not know. He therefore wants the player and Méabh to collect the cream inside the palisade.
As for milk, there are two dairy farmers in the north who usually each leave a can outside.
He wants the promised quantities collected during the night and returned to him. Méabh understands the collection as a supply route; the player is likely to understand it as taking neighbours' offerings. A concealed Fairy Door in the lower chamber opens into the woods west of Trí Mhuilinn, well outside the palisade.
storyBeats.objective: Learn what must be collected and where to find it.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep Coinín literally truthful but strategically incomplete. He does not claim he can consume the food and does not reveal the Takeling/clone supply chain. Use the existing Grace and Bargain rules to explain that the goods discharge part of an obligation; do not invent a numeric Grace reward. Let the player choose the surface path or Coinín's Fairy Door to the Hidden Fairy Door in the western woods. The portal requires no check, but it does not bypass the watched palisade or the collection challenges.

storyBeats.title: The Watched Palisade
storyBeats.events: Recently, someone stole horseshoes from doors and from the smithy. This has changed the village routine. One watchman guards the palisade gate while another patrols inside. The team must choose whether to sneak, bluff, use a familiar route, create a distraction, or explain themselves.
storyBeats.objective: Enter the village without alarming the watch.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Use Village Guard - Prototype 01 and 02 for the watchmen. Make the watchmen alert rather than murderous. A failed approach may cost Cover or Nerve, create suspicion, require a favour, split the route, or force a new plan. It must not prevent collection or turn the Mission into combat.

storyBeats.title: Bowls at the Thresholds
storyBeats.events: Bowls, pots, and covered vessels sit at selected thresholds. Some are easy to reach; others lie near dogs, wakeful families, creaking gates, iron charms, or the patrol's route. Update the cream Mission Tracker immediately as measures are secured.
storyBeats.objective: Gather the promised cream from sleeping households.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Offer several small problems and let player choices determine which houses they risk. Do not roll for every vessel. Use checks only where discovery or loss is meaningfully at stake. On failure, spill or lose some progress, attract attention, create a social consequence, or demand a different route; always leave enough opportunities to reach both targets.

storyBeats.title: Milk and Geese
storyBeats.events:
The team must collect two cans of milk from two dairy farms in the north. Each farmer has placed one can outside the door.
- First farm: The can by the door can normally be taken without trouble. More cans stand inside the fenced yard. The yard appears unguarded, but an aggressive territorial rooster attacks anyone who enters.
- Second farm: One can stands outside the door. As the team approaches, they may alert the geese, which defend the milk and may make enough noise to wake the farmer. More cans stand inside the yard.
storyBeats.objective: Collect two cans of milk from the dairy farms.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Have the player decide whether to take one can from each farm and confront the geese, or take two cans from the first farm and enter its yard. Treat the geese as the known problem: they can be seen from afar. Treat the first farm's yard as the unknown risk: the rooster attack must be a surprise. Update the milk Mission Tracker whenever a can is secured.

storyBeats.title: Payment in Milk
storyBeats.events: The team returns to Coinín's Hollow Tree with ten measures of cream and two cans of milk, by the woodland Fairy Door or another viable route. He checks the quantities with professional exactness and acknowledges that those portions of the promised payment have been delivered. Two measures of honey remain due unless Iron and Wax was completed first.
storyBeats.objective: Deliver the collected goods and record what remains owed.
storyBeats.gmInstructions: Keep both tracker values at target as historical Mission-object progress once delivery is complete; these counters record the objective, not carried inventory. Update Coinín's Silence to record delivery of the cream and milk. Resolve the accepting party's combined obligation only if the honey was already delivered through Iron and Wax. Coinín's nondisclosure obligation remains active.

description: Milk and cream wait outside sleeping homes, but recent thefts have put Trí Mhuilinn's watchmen on edge. Collecting the offerings without waking the village will teach what the Good People regard as payment—and what humans call stealing.
completionEffects: Record the cream and milk as delivered under Coinín's Silence. If Iron and Wax has already delivered the two measures of honey, mark the accepting party's joint goods obligation resolved; otherwise leave it unresolved. Coinín's promise not to tell Morrigan remains an active obligation. Do not advance the moon phase.
